claims.text: The source asks for two threads alternating odd/even numbers but does not specify range, first parity, synchronization primitive, or interruption policy.

The candidate uses a single monitor-protected next counter; parity is a guard, wait is rechecked in a while loop, state advancement and output are serialized, and termination wakes any remaining waiter.
The exact candidate compiles and emits exactly 0..maxInclusive under both startup orders across deterministic and seeded randomized executions with bounded termination.
